cm-parents-and-children-1904.author: Mason, Charlotte M.
cm-parents-and-children-1904.title: Parents and Children
cm-parents-and-children-1904.notes: Home Education Series, Volume 2. Mason d. 1923 — public domain worldwide regardless of edition. Verified 2026-08-01: PG ebook #72445 reproduces the ORIGINAL 1897 first edition (title page dated 1897, dedication Nov. 1896; a collection of Parents' Review articles). Mason recast a slimmer edition as Series Vol. 2 in 1904 when she reorganised her books into the six-volume Home Education Series; that specific 1904 printing has no separately confirmed PG digitisation. Flag for Drew: worth sanity-checking which edition authoring should draw on (licence status is unaffected either way).

cm-school-education-1905.author: Mason, Charlotte M.
cm-school-education-1905.title: School Education
cm-school-education-1905.notes: Home Education Series, Volume 3. Mason d. 1923 — public domain worldwide. Verified 2026-08-01: first edition 1905 (preface dated November 1904); PG ebook #77188 reproduces the Second Edition (Kegan Paul, Trench, Trübner & Co., Ltd., London, 1907).

cm-ourselves-1905.author: Mason, Charlotte M.
cm-ourselves-1905.title: Ourselves

plato-republic-jowett.title: The Republic
plato-republic-jowett.notes: Benjamin Jowett's translation (3rd ed., 1888) — pre-1930, public domain. PG ebook #150; an improved edition incorporating the 1908 two-volume Stephanus numbering is also on PG at #55201.

aristotle-politics-jowett.author: Aristotle; trans. Jowett, Benjamin
aristotle-politics-jowett.title: The Politics of Aristotle
aristotle-politics-jowett.notes: Jowett's translation, Clarendon Press, Oxford, 1885 (published posthumously edited) — pre-1930, public domain. PG number to confirm — verified 2026-08-01 that Project Gutenberg's Politics ebook (#6762) is the William Ellis translation, not Jowett's; archive.org scan of the Jowett edition used instead. Note re: Ethics — Jowett did NOT translate the Nicomachean Ethics (usually attributed to other pre-1930 translators, e.g. F. H. Peters or W. D. Ross); register a separate key if an Ethics excerpt is needed rather than assuming this entry covers it.
